p.src: A Psalm. A song for the Sabbath day.

en: A Psalm. A song for the Sabbath day.
u.src: A Psalm. A song for the Sabbath day.

p.src: 1  It is a good thing to give thanks to the LORD, to sing praises to your name, Most High,

en: It is a good thing to give thanks to the LORD, to sing praises to your name, Most High,
u.src: 1  It is a good thing to give thanks to the LORD, to sing praises to your name, Most High,

p.src: 2  to proclaim your loving kindness in the morning, and your faithfulness every night,

en: to proclaim your loving kindness in the morning, and your faithfulness every night,
u.src: 2  to proclaim your loving kindness in the morning, and your faithfulness every night,

p.src: 3  with the ten-stringed lute, with the harp, and with the melody of the lyre.

en: with the ten-stringed lute, with the harp, and with the melody of the lyre.
u.src: 3  with the ten-stringed lute, with the harp, and with the melody of the lyre.

p.src: 4  For you, LORD, have made me glad through your work. I will triumph in the works of your hands.

en: For you, LORD, have made me glad through your work. I will triumph in the works of your hands.
u.src: 4  For you, LORD, have made me glad through your work. I will triumph in the works of your hands.

p.src: 5  How great are your works, LORD! Your thoughts are very deep.

en: How great are your works, LORD! Your thoughts are very deep.
u.src: 5  How great are your works, LORD! Your thoughts are very deep.

p.src: 6  A senseless man doesn’t know, neither does a fool understand this:

en: A senseless man doesn’t know, neither does a fool understand this:
u.src: 6  A senseless man doesn’t know, neither does a fool understand this:

p.src: 7  though the wicked spring up as the grass, and all the evildoers flourish, they will be destroyed forever.

en: though the wicked spring up as the grass, and all the evildoers flourish, they will be destroyed forever.
u.src: 7  though the wicked spring up as the grass, and all the evildoers flourish, they will be destroyed forever.

p.src: 8  But you, LORD, are on high forever more.

en: But you, LORD, are on high forever more.
u.src: 8  But you, LORD, are on high forever more.

p.src: 9  For behold, your enemies, LORD, for behold, your enemies shall perish. All the evildoers will be scattered.

en: For behold, your enemies, LORD, for behold, your enemies shall perish. All the evildoers will be scattered.
u.src: 9  For behold, your enemies, LORD, for behold, your enemies shall perish. All the evildoers will be scattered.

p.src: 10  But you have exalted my horn like that of the wild ox. I am anointed with fresh oil.

en: But you have exalted my horn like that of the wild ox. I am anointed with fresh oil.
u.src: 10  But you have exalted my horn like that of the wild ox. I am anointed with fresh oil.

p.src: 11  My eye has also seen my enemies. My ears have heard of the wicked enemies who rise up against me.

en: My eye has also seen my enemies. My ears have heard of the wicked enemies who rise up against me.
u.src: 11  My eye has also seen my enemies. My ears have heard of the wicked enemies who rise up against me.

p.src: 12  The righteous shall flourish like the palm tree. He will grow like a cedar in Lebanon.

en: The righteous shall flourish like the palm tree. He will grow like a cedar in Lebanon.
u.src: 12  The righteous shall flourish like the palm tree. He will grow like a cedar in Lebanon.

p.src: 13  They are planted in the LORD’s house. They will flourish in our God’s courts.

en: They are planted in the LORD’s house. They will flourish in our God’s courts.
u.src: 13  They are planted in the LORD’s house. They will flourish in our God’s courts.

p.src: 14  They will still produce fruit in old age. They will be full of sap and green,

en: They will still produce fruit in old age. They will be full of sap and green,
u.src: 14  They will still produce fruit in old age. They will be full of sap and green,

p.src: 15  to show that the LORD is upright. He is my rock, and there is no unrighteousness in him.

en: to show that the LORD is upright. He is my rock, and there is no unrighteousness in him.
u.src: 15  to show that the LORD is upright. He is my rock, and there is no unrighteousness in him.
